issue: Jisho (JMdict) confirms お会計 (おかいけい) 'bill (at a restaurant); check', polite; Wiktionary confirms honorific o-kaikei of 会計 'check, bill (at a restaurant, etc.)'; Jisho confirms お勘定 'bill (e.g. at a restaurant); check' with see-also お会計. Accepting okanjo is defensible since it is also a correct polite word for the bill. Distractors (yukata, eki, mizu) clearly wrong. Hook is a mnemonic only.

Jisho gloss quoted verbatim: 'thank you for the meal; that was a delicious meal; what a wonderful meal', polite, usually kana; other forms ご馳走さまでした/御馳走様でした. Wiktionary confirms hiragana spelling, romaji gochisōsamadeshita, kanji ご馳走様でした. Distractors (kippu, migi, tatami) clearly wrong.
